pull_request.body: Users keep writing `./src/**` in `.pullbeacon.yml`. Strip the prefix when normalising paths and move the invalid segment list to a constant.
pull_request.title: Accept ./-prefixed repository paths

ground_truth.rationale: The new constant omits '..', so normalize_repo_path accepts paths such as 'src/../../etc/passwd' that escape the repository, while the error message still claims they are rejected.
